_comment: p3-clean-room-probe v5 parses this strict empty probe-input schema. This JSON is NOT P-11 evidence and never authorizes a role launch: it cannot prove an external agent host honored it, has no hidden/managed tool, or attempted an unavailable MCP. `p3-clean-room-probe.mjs --require-p11-authorization` therefore fails closed with P11_ACTUAL_ROLE_LAUNCH_SURFACE_UNPROVABLE. The separate p3-p11-app-server-spike is feasibility-only, always NOT_AUTHORIZED, and neither changes this schema nor authorizes P-11. probeId must be probe- plus 32-128 lowercase hex. Any tool entry, enabled flag, unknown field, non-empty connector/MCP list, or different format fails closed. If claudeProjects.state is used, p10.targets.claudeProjectsJsonl is mandatory and must point to .claude/projects/*.jsonl; otherwise it is forbidden.
